provenance.evidence: The territorial maritime-history record states that the original light first operated in 1819, the substantially current tower replaced it on 1 October 1862, and a 1949 restoration gave the tower its current appearance. The territorial authority separately calls it an emblematic monument at the entrance to Saint-Pierre's old port. Territorial maritime history dates the tower replacement to1862 and current appearance to1949, with octagonal upper support. Original tapered octagonal tower/lantern symbol; no modern access works or night illumination copied. All dimensions, colours, simplifications and composition proportions are original art direction, not source measurements. No surveyed-location, current-access, production-quality or legal-rights approval is asserted.
